entities.name: Dinitra La Croix
entities.description: A sorceress who fought in the Great Magus War on Antausia and conquered Beldingard for its mana pools.

entities.name: Antausia
entities.description: The plane where the Great Magus War was fought.

entities.name: Beldingard
entities.description: A realm with pure magical energy pools, conquered and held by Dinitra for nearly 80 years.

entities.name: Ignatius Firestorm
entities.description: A leader who challenged Dinitra with an army that harnessed the energies of Beldingard's pools.

events.summary: Dinitra learns of the pure magical energy pools of Beldingard and conquers the realm to access its mana.
events.quote: She conquered the realm so she would have direct access to its mana pools and held the area for nearly 80 years.

events.summary: Ignatius Firestorm and Valdusian Tomer challenge Dinitra with an army that harnesses the same energies; she watches in horror.
events.quote: Ignatius Firestorm and his apprentice Valdusian Tomer challenged her with an army

relations.quote: Ignatius Firestorm and his apprentice Valdusian Tomer

relations.note: Ignatius challenged her with an army.
